notes.title: Game Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
It is time to pull out your six-shooters again as the game has received an update:
- A few achievements have been fixed
- Some goals have been fixed
- A few potential crashes have been fixed
- And also some minor bugs have been fixed

We are still fixing a mean crash, but hoping to put out another update as soon as possible!
